The '''Contest''' was a [[Silika]] tradition where two individuals engaged in a drinking contest, imbibing [[Silika water]], which was basically [[mineral water]]. The water interacted with their [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]]-based physiology, and acted similar to how [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] acted on [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. [[Kemmel Attapi]] was the reigning champion until he challenged the Human [[Dannen Lifehold]]. The Contest ended with Lifehold winning due to the fact that the Silika water had no effect on his system.
